name: One multi-holding household receives only one active notice

statusDetails.message: POST /scarcity/evaluate A twice after three holdings for 12 and queue 4 returned the same active notice-10, selectedBookingId null; GET /views showed one active notice and all three holdings.

labels.name: feature
labels.value: Scarcity notice on a standing holding

labels.name: story
labels.value: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household

steps.name: Given: Given one household holds three standing slots in a full eligible group; And an eligible household is waiting in that group
When: When scarcity is evaluated twice before the first notice lapses
Then: Then only one notice is active for that multi-holding household; And no second holding is selected for loss by the repeated evaluation
